scope: Source-only next-stage design, conditional on whole96 E qualification. No Source/test edits, implementation, imported numerical modules, experiments, state/force/PCM/E payload or archived raw-data access.
recommendation: Specify an event-relative persistent contact service first, initially on one unchanged speaking geometry. Separate immutable ContactRecipe from live ContactInstance and lifetime physical-string state; only then qualify ringing same-note repicks. Do not land another finite-crop tap callback or per-note initialized field.

new_concrete_findings.finding: attach accepts only the original absolute first Contact time. A later live repick requires an explicit event clock/origin, not replay of that case timestamp.

SupportPath embeds absolute Contact/Release, allocates withdrawal knots to calls96, and refuses evaluation past the original crop at line40. It is a finite-study actuator, not an indefinite live string service.

Written fret/baseFrequency update before a queued wrist arrives. A new mechanical basis must not be re-keyed from these logical fields during a sounding transition. Finger-contact targets and performed field geometry need distinct ownership.

The qualified kernel explicitly rejects j>2. Retaining old/new fretting contacts while a pick is attached can require at least3 scalar force ports; J2 unit evidence does not cover that topology. Count actual independent constraints/ports before choosing a solver boundary.

minimum_service_contract.PhysicalString: Own persistent two-axis q/v, fixed spatial basis/material coordinates, cumulative work/D and active contact storage independently of MIDI ownership and audible Voice.active. Initialize at engine prepare/reset; NoteOff, pending cancellation or silenceVoice is not permission to erase mechanical energy.
minimum_service_contract.ContactRecipe: Owned existing pulse, release pole, spatial/axis weights, numerical contact stiffness and source setpoint inputs. No fitted actuator duration, knee, gain or human-contact calibration added.
minimum_service_contract.ContactInstance: Actual event boundary clock/order, y/v at attachment, support z/zdot/path progress, withdrawal filter state and cumulative release mass, active contact U and lifetime work. Same-note events cannot overwrite positive-U contacts.
minimum_service_contract.causal_withdrawal: For the same declared pulse/pole, a causal realization is r[k]=(1-a)*p[k]+a*r[k-1], R[k]=R[k-1]+r[k], z[k]=y_attach+D-2*D*R[k], with the existing PWL sides between fixed96k knots. Preserve initial states and exact operation-order evidence. Prove agreement with the owned finite prefix before using it; no tail renormalization, arbitrary cutoff, or claimed untested bitidentity.
minimum_service_contract.arrival_seam: Retain immediate and deferred startExcitation semantics. The delayed path renders its pending sample before countdown commit (Engine.cpp10005-10039). Record arrival boundary and first Contact-rendered clock distinctly; do not guess a universal plus/minus-one offset.
minimum_service_contract.observer: Keep one uninterrupted magnetic previousFlux/EMF/loaded-coil/output/decimator history from the initial rest state; no new prime at repick or Release, and no duplicate old spatial aperture on a physical spatial read.
minimum_service_contract.ledger: Keep Estring+sum(Ucontact)-Estart-Wexternal+D across the entire event sequence. Do not restart this ledger at every pluck. Keep existing force/native/applied-Gram/gather/work gates; characteristic .5FqD is not initial stored energy.

ownership_decisions_before_fret_or_overl: A new stroke arriving while the same pick contact has U>0 needs a declared continuation/retarget/queue policy preserving z, zdot, q/v and U. Recalling unstrained attach or silently replacing the old port is invalid. An unresolved busy contact must remain an explicit failed/unavailable performance event, not be silently delayed or deleted.

For fret changes, use one persistent full-open physical basis or an explicitly work-accounted exact representation change. A fixed-open basis avoids coefficient-index replacement but does not establish that its finger/fret constraints match a simply-supported short string; slope/moment transfer and resulting mode frequencies must be checked without frequency fitting.

The existing x5/x7,k6000,d0 ports are numerical fixtures, not calibrated steel frets or finger-behind-fret geometry. Actual fretting contact law, old-finger unloading, independent port count and simultaneous pick scheduling remain specific ownership prerequisites.

If a topology requires3ports, either qualify its complete coupled solver or prospectively define a reduced constrained system that retains reaction work and full damping. Do not remove an old constraint or serialize a real event merely to reuse J2 proof.

Bend/tension/mass/stiffness changes require their own parameter-work account. The first persistent same-geometry stage can keep these fixed; production configureVoicePitch is not such a physical work law.
minimum_meaningful_qualification_sequenc: 1. Before DSP edits, freeze ContactRecipe/Instance/event-clock and active-port lifecycle contract. Validate a bounded causal actuator against unchanged declared source knots, including left/right Release sides and indefinite post-crop operation. This does not select physical hand parameters.

2. Persistent single-string/same-geometry mechanical prototype: one initial rest state, then ringing same-note repicks after retirement and during Contact/withdrawal; include same-clock ownership, older NoteOff, pending cancellation and CC64. Preserve q/v and all remaining U; retain busy-conflict failures. Use complete force/work/D/construction and first/refined continuous/event gates unchanged, not output continuity alone.

3. Qualify a separate persistent fret handoff (both directions, interrupted/queued/legato takeover) with explicit old/new contact work/storage and actual port count, retaining cutoff/rate/local-velocity/HF/event and frequency-consistency failures. No per-note q/v reset, delay glide, signal crossfade or unexplained0.28 physical choke.

4. Only after these mechanics pass, carry continuous spatial pickup and electrical history through a whole event sequence; recheck original engine ownership/repick/refret/release tests without weakening their numerical rails. Alias, fixed-memory/CPU/host feasibility remain separate qualifications.

5. Then compare NEW current-shipping6c83 A against that complete continuous candidate on whole registered P3 source06 phrases and source12 register checks, retaining all events/windows and fixed whole-crop level convention. No isolated-E stitching, per-note gain/EQ, inferred hand-force groundtruth or95percent score.

production_source_anchors.role: PendingRepick is intent/scheduler state, not a mechanical contact.
repickHeldString preserves physical string and durable owner.
Current refret handoff reuses Contact time as engineering duration, explicitly not identified physical fret duration.
Actual-contact latch; new port must replace its owned legacy excitation/choke, not be added twice.
Legato takes the currently performed incoming endpoint; preserve this ownership semantics.
Pending cancellation distinguishes never-arrived contact from old ringing release.
Audible silence clears logical/excitation state; keep physical-state lifetime separate.
Continuous Faraday/EMF history; do not reset at a newly scheduled contact.
